stories.title: Clan Gathering
stories.detail: The Wakefield clan sent Harry and Lachlan out today and both came home with something to show.

stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: Good to see Paul Higginbotham up from Yowani CC, and we hope the greens were kind.

stories.title: The Golf Tax Strikes Again
stories.detail: 3-pointer to 1-pointer on holes 9 & 10 - the course always takes its cut

stories.title: The Golf Tax
stories.detail: One good hole then one bad on holes 1 & 2 - the course charges a fee for everything

stories.title: In the Wet
stories.detail: The rain gauge tipped 11.6 and the field simply put the head down and kept going.

stories.title: From the Movies
stories.detail: Chariots of Fire on the beach, Andrew Uhr on the fairway, 4 pts and sand flying everywhere.
